sophia: FYI current main is CI-red, intermittent failure in runtime.TestRetryBackoff on linux-ubuntu-20.04 (CI job https://ci.redwood.ai/4567). Happens ~1/30 runs. stacktrace points to timeout in backoff manager.
mike: thanks — kicking a rerun now./rerun 4567
ci-bot: Job 4567 rerun queued by @mike, est ~3m.
kevin: saw the trace, looks like TestRetryBackoff/TestFastRetry hits "context deadline exceeded" inside retry.go:142 (backoff loop). Could be timer jitter + kv-cache prefetch timing.
anya: can someone try `go test ./runtime -run TestRetryBackoff -count 100` on linux? that'll tell us frequency locally. Also try with GOMAXPROCS=1 and `-race` flag.
mike: running loop now (linux VM). `GOMAXPROCS=1 go test ./runtime -run TestRetryBackoff -count 100` — will report.
sophia: fwiw last change touching timers was PR #4321 (adaptive backoff jitter). If flaky, might be culprit. cc @kevin can you bisect?
kevin: I can. Planning: `git bisect start HEAD v2026.11 -- scripts/ci/test_once.sh` then use `./scripts/ci/check_test_fail.sh runtime TestRetryBackoff`. If anyone has a faster binary-level repro, paste it.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: 4567 -> failed again (2/3 runs). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/4567/logs.
mike: local loop: 100 runs -> 3 failures. attaching minimal log snippet: ```
--- FAIL: TestRetryBackoff (0.21s)
    backoff_test.go:78: expected retry count 3, got 0
    retry.go:142: context deadline exceeded
```
anya: interesting that retry count = 0, meaning the backoff loop might be skipping due to time skew or signal. Can we add a quick assert/log around when retry loop starts? even a `t.Logf` would help.
sophia: short-term mitigation: mark test flaky in CI with `flake:retry=2` so PRs don't get blocked, but we should not merge that until bisect root cause identified.
kevin: started bisect run. If I get a reproducer seed, I'll try to add deterministic fake clock. Bisect ETA ~20m.
sophia: if bisect points at #4321 we should consider reverting and re-run heavy canary before merge.
mike: noted. Also assigning myself to open an issue with reproduction steps and add a TODO to convert test to use a fake clock.
ci-bot: Bisect job 4599 queued by @kevin.
anya: tagging this thread `#triage` and adding a note to the weekly flaky spreadsheet.
kevin: update: bisect narrowed failure to commit `a7d3c9f` (touches adaptive jitter). Trying a quick patch to reduce jitter range.
sophia: thanks — keep us posted. if someone finds an easy repro script, paste it here and I'll try a hotfix PR. :thumbsup:
